thread:
emma.sales: BridgeBank POC ask: they want a SOC2 excerpt + signed pen-test attestation, and theyre asking if we can provision ephemeral KMS keys for an auditor-run external scan. Any quick blockers?
owen.se: Feasible. We can issue ephemeral creds and presigned upload links. Need confirmation on outbound egress and whether they want single-tenant KMS isolation.
kara.sec: Security items: (1) pen-test attestation requires buyer signer name and contact, we can provide draft; (2) for Private/On-prem ephemeral KMS we need KMS owner approval + a 1-page runbook; (3) SOC2 artifacts will be redacted.
emma.sales: Theyre pushing to have everything in three business days. Can we get the draft attestation + SOC2 redacted bundle by then?
sam.pm: I'll assemble a compact evidence package. Kara, what's our redaction pattern?
kara.sec: Standard redaction: strip internal IP ranges, internal hostnames, and service-account emails. Ill drop the checklist into the folder. compliance-bot: SOC2 redacted excerpt uploaded: https://files.redwood.example/soc2/bridgebank-2026-05-01.zip
owen.se: For ephemeral KMS we need (a) staging CIDR(s) for allowlisting, (b) preferred key rotation window. Also note Dedicated KMS isolation affects pricing.
emma.sales: CIDRs sent in the RFP. I'll confirm rotation window and signer. Please add Dedicated+KMS delta to the quote.
owen.se: Rough estimate: Dedicated + single-tenant KMS = +$3,750/month (ballpark). Final after infra signoff.
kara.sec: If they insist on independent 3rd-party red-team evidence rather than our attestation, add ~2 weeks to the delivery timeline.
sam.pm: Evidence checklist Im preparing: 1) SOC2 redacted excerpt 2) minimal network diagram 3) pen-test attestation draft 4) KMS keyflow sketch 5) presigned upload snippet 6) ephemeral creds runbook
emma.sales: can you paste the presigned snippet so I can forward to their infra?
owen.se: presign example:
```bash
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-evidence/bridgebank-poc.zip --expires-in 3600
```
kara.sec: Security guidance: expiry <=1h, single-use tracking, require request_id in logs.
emma.sales: They also want attestation language to confirm we support on-prem HSM integrations. Safe to include?
kara.sec: Allowed phrasing: "Redwood supports Private deployments with customer-managed KMS/HSM integrations." Do not list or claim specific HSM vendors unless validated.
sam.pm: I'll upload the bundle and loop Legal for a quick sign-off on the attestation wording. compliance-bot: Pen-test-attestation-template_v1.docx uploaded: https://files.redwood.example/templates/pen-test-attestation_bridgebank_v1.docx
emma.sales: Thanks team  Ill send to BridgeBank and request signer details. Will update here if anything changes. :thumbsup:
